title: collab.v1 shared schema definitions
description: Shared $defs for the collab.v1 collaboration contracts frozen by C05a (REV-C). This file is a library, not a DTO: it has no golden vectors of its own. Every DTO in this directory is closed (additionalProperties false) and references these shapes by $ref.

uuid.description: Canonical lower-case UUID text (8-4-4-4-12). The version nibble is deliberately not restricted so a future UUIDv7 remains representable.

namespace.description: Single collaboration namespace. Every reference in this directory is namespace-scoped and must stay inside the owner's namespace.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC / RFC 3339 instant. The pattern checks syntactic shape only; calendar correctness belongs to the state layer.

nullable_timestamp_utc.description: An unknown or not-yet-reached instant is null, never invented.

sha256_digest.description: Prefixed SHA-256 digest of the exact UTF-8 bytes named by the field (body text, canonical JSON or rendered input).

hex64.description: Bare 64-character lower-case hex digest, used where the store already owns an unprefixed hash (candidate.command_digest is the Tx B _request_digest value).

privacy_class.description: Content privacy class, same closed set as pcs.v2. It is not an outbound-authorization flag.

retention.description: Ordered retention policy: session < standard < durable, most-to-least restrictive. Durations are resolved by the store policy registry (C05b), never encoded here.

readability.description: Read-side state of one experience reference. Storage objects never carry it.

content_version.description: Version of one immutable collaboration text (input or artifact), starting at 1.

generation.description: Work generation. It starts at 0 and is incremented only by the rejection transaction.

event_ref.description: Typed reference to a pcs.v2 Event. A bare ID is not representable.

record_ref.description: Typed reference to an exact pcs.v2 Record version.

read_set_entry.description: One read-set entry. ref is always a RecordRef: collaboration references and EventRefs never enter a read_set.

collab_input_ref.description: Typed reference to one immutable collaboration input version.

collab_artifact_ref.description: Typed reference to one immutable collaboration artifact version (an ordinary reply or a candidate).

collaboration_ref.description: Union of the two collaboration reference shapes accepted by delete_experience. Exactly one branch matches.

source_ref.description: Union of the four legal source shapes: pcs.v2 event, pcs.v2 record, collaboration input, collaboration artifact. Exactly one branch matches.

attempt_ref.description: Reference to one model attempt. request_hash uses the stored model_attempts form (sha256:<hex>) and must equal it exactly.

proposal_version.description: Version label of the proposal contract applied to a candidate; lower-case dotted token.
